shots.camText: Close-up of Helena over his shoulder · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "I know where it is, buddy."

lines.text: HELENA: I know where it is, buddy.

shots.note: Sharp. Continues from Q05's last frame (his close-up).

shots.camText: Her point of view: Oren frontal, centred, chest up · 28 mm · locked-off
shots.note: Waiting still: everything moves behind him (people passing both ways, a sweeper), he alone is still; slow blinks; eyes on her.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena over his shoulder · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "Sorry. You are trying to help."

lines.text: HELENA: Sorry. You are trying to help.

shots.note: Her inner brows rise; softened, an apology.

shots.camText: Insert: her right hand against the laundrette's green pillar · 50 mm · handheld
shots.note: Her palm goes flat on the painted pillar; her weight comes off one leg; a short inhale through the teeth.

shots.camText: Close-up of Oren over her shoulder · 85 mm · locked-off
shots.note: His eyes go to her hand on the wall and come back to her face.

shots.camText: Big close-up of Helena · 85 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "Oh, we know each other." · OREN (off): "You and —" · HELENA: "Me and the pain. Yeah."

lines.text: HELENA: Oh, we know each other.
HELENA: Me and the pain. Yeah.

shots.note: A pain tell, then a dry half-smile; her lips stay closed while he speaks off-screen; then tired, almost fond.

shots.camText: Medium profile two-shot on the pavement · eye level · 40 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "Would you like assistance sitting down?"

lines.text: OREN: Would you like assistance sitting down?

shots.note: Asked, not offered: his hands stay at his sides. People pass behind them.
